Name: Blender 5.3
Tagline: 3D Gaussian splats, now native to Blender
Description: Blender 5.3 adds native 3D Gaussian Splats across Geometry Nodes, Workbench, EEVEE, and Cycles, alongside DLSS 4.5 viewport denoising, optional Project setups, Compositor scene effects, Material Lighting nodes, and ripple video editing.

Name: MAP & GO!
Tagline: See your day on the map
Description: MAP & GO! puts your day on the map: tasks and events land on a place, weather sits on the pin, and AI is one tap away, so you can find a place, look around, and navigate without leaving the app, with Apple and Google connected.

Name: Valutorio
Tagline: Your Markdown notes, native on Mac and iPhone
Description: Free Mac and iPhone app that opens the Markdown vault you already keep, nothing to import. Wikilinks, backlinks, search, daily notes, a graph on the Mac. Sync ($5.99/mo) keeps Mac and iPhone the same and lets your AI read and write your notes over MCP.

Name: VB Notes
Tagline: Markdown notes in your own folder, searched by meaning
Topics: Android, Productivity, Open Source, Notes, GitHub
Description: A free, open-source notes app for iPhone, Android, Mac, Windows and Linux. Every note is a plainmd file in a folder you choose, edited in a Bear-style editor with nested tags. Search by meaning runs on the device, offline. No account.

Name: AnyoneHiring.today
Tagline: A world map of jobs. “Anywhere” is now a plan.
Description: See who’s hiring worldwide. Filter by city, pay, or work style, then sign in to open the original listing. There are paid gigs too, because rent doesn’t care about your five-year plan.

Name: Aboard Sign
Tagline: Email a contract, CC sign@aboard.com and collect signatures
Description: Get a contract signed with no account or app: email it to everyone who signs, CC sign@aboard.com, and each person gets a link to read and sign it in the browser. Everyone is mailed the signed PDF, every page cryptographically signed. The document isn't kept.

Name: Restoration Scope
Tagline: Field data and monitoring software for reforestation
Description: Restoration Scope is field data and monitoring software for reforestation, nature restoration and carbon projects. Field teams record plots, plantings, survival and geotagged photos on their phones, offline too. We set up maps, dashboards and data quality checks, and public portals for funders. Carbon developers keep the plot records their verifier checks. Used by One Tree Planted, Acción Andina, One Acre Fund and Ponterra. Free pilot on a sample of your data; no per-user or per-hectare fees.

Name: HiringNow
Tagline: AI job agent that finds & apply for jobs before anyone else.
Description: HiringNow checks 247,000+ company career sites every 5 minutes, so you see new jobs before they hit the big boards. It matches each job to your profile, tailors your resume and cover letter, and applies on the employer's own site, only with your approval. Every application gets a receipt in your job tracker. Also: resume builder and mock interviews. Free plan with 10 auto-applies.

Name: Antelog
Tagline: Stops AI coding agents from leaking or destroying your data
Description: AI coding agents are amazing. Until one deletes your database, or leaks your secrets. Antelog stops the disasters before they happen, and shows you everything your AI did: every command, every website, every bit of data it sent. Works with Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Free.

Name: Dex Semantics
Tagline: Let your agent build analytics with 25% fewer errors
Topics: Analytics, Developer Tools, GitHub, Data & Analytics
Description: Dex Semantics adds declarations to your analytical models, which capture row meaning, join nature, how numbers add up, and decisional assumptions. Thanks to this, Dex scores 80% on ADE-bench with Claude Sonnet 5.5, compared to 73.3% without Dex (25% fewer tasks failed). Declarations live in your models as code, not a third-party tool. Dex then helps your agent convert declarations into your Semantic Layer of choice.

Name: Gemini Robotics 2.5
Tagline: Gemini Robotics 2.5: Google’s most capable robot model
Description: Gemini Robotics 2.5 is Google DeepMind’s most capable vision-language-action model, turning what a robot sees and is told into hand and arm movements. Per DeepMind, it has a 30% to 100% higher success rate than the previous baseline, finishes tasks 20% to 30% faster, and reached 96% success in a Mercedes-Benz parts-kitting pilot with Apptronik’s Apollo 2 humanoid. Works across robot types. Rolling out to robotics partners.

Name: Replay
Tagline: Mac meeting recorder with no bot. Pay once, no subscription
Description: Replay records your Google Meet, Zoom and Teams calls right from your Mac, so no notetaker bot joins the call and nobody has to let one in. Your voice and theirs land on separate tracks, and the transcript, summary and action items are made on your Mac. Recordings stay local in ordinary files, and you can search every past meeting. Pay once, activate two Macs, no subscription. Needs Apple silicon and macOS 26 or later.

Name: inread.app
Tagline: your newsletters, outside your inbox
Description: inread gives you a private @inread.app address just for newsletters. They land in a clean, tracker-free reader instead of your inbox. Highlight what matters and take it to Obsidian, Readwise or any notes app in Markdown.

Name: Tacie
Tagline: Meeting notes on your Mac, with no bot in the call
Description: Someone asks, "Why did we decide this?" and no one remembers. The answer is somewhere in a doc from months ago. Tacie listens on your Mac, with no bot in the call. When a question like that comes up, it looks up the answer in your past meetings and connected tools like Notion, Jira and Linear, and shows the answer and its source during the meeting. When the meeting ends, Tacie writes up the decisions, to-dos and open questions.

Name: CodeMesh
Tagline: Cut AI coding costs by 90%
Topics: Software Engineering, Developer Tools, Vibe coding
Description: CodeMesh helps AI coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf understand your code faster. Instead of reading the same files again and again, CodeMesh gives them only the code they need. This can reduce token usage and AI costs by over 90%, while making coding agents faster and more efficient. You keep using your favorite coding tool CodeMesh simply makes it smarter and cheaper.

Name: Horef Rings
Tagline: Any metric on any Apple Watch face, plus a daily score
Description: Put any of 75 metrics on any watch face as a complication, or three in one field. Plus iPhone widgets and Headroom, a daily 0–10 score from your sleep and vitals. Free to try, one-time Pro, no account, no ads.

Name: Drops
Tagline: Discover new music through moments your friends love
Description: Drops is a social music discovery app from HARMAN, the company behind JBL. Explore 10–30-second moments from songs, handpicked by people who love them. Discover new artists, follow people whose taste you trust, react to their picks, and save your favorites to Droplists. Every Drop combines music, lyrics, artwork, and a personal story about why that moment matters. Find your next favorite song through people, not just playlists.

Name: ScreenGo
Tagline: screen recorder for Mac with auto zooms and virtual webcam
Description: A Mac screen recorder with a camera bubble, teleprompter and an editor that does the polish for you: zooms, cursor, captions and clean sound. No account, nothing leaves your Mac.

Name: Kokonut UI
Tagline: Open-source UI components for your AI agent
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: Kokonut UI is a free, MIT-licensed library of 100+ React components made for coding agents. Connect through MCP in Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code or Codex, ask for "a tool approval card in my chat", and your agent finds the component, installs it and edits it in your repo. Every docs page is also served as Markdown for agents. This release adds 65 components and rebuilds 34, led by AI chat parts: tool calls, tool approval, diff review, citations and more.

Name: Nexus
Tagline: One visual graph for all your projects
Description: Nexus maps your software projects and every service they depend on in one visual graph. Click any node to open its dashboard. No account needed, your data stays in your browser. Free for up to 3 projects.
